beats.label: The study
beats.text: **51** middle-aged adults sat in a **73°C** Finnish sauna, with a cool shower midway.

beats.label: What happened
beats.text: Circulating **white** **blood** **cells** rose right after the session.

beats.label: Then
beats.text: Neutrophils and lymphocytes were back to **baseline** within **30** **minutes.**

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: One session, no **control** **group.** A short spike isn't proof of a **stronger** immune system.
